explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() and next_token() to walk the fragment in document order, appending decoded #text nodes plus TITLE/TEXTAREA opener text via get_modifiable_text(), while skipping script/style content implicitly because it is not ordinary text. I then truncated the accumulated UTF-8 string to the requested code-point limit with mb_strlen/mb_substr, with a regex fallback if mbstring is unavailable.
